title: Cross-project failure-shapes and local gate crosswalk
mode: Primary-source issue and documentation review with local source/test inventory; no peer runtime
scope: Screen recent LibreDWG and OpenCADStudio reports for source-backed failure shapes relevant to DXF/DWG reader, writer, resource, and consumer boundaries.
Crosswalk reports against existing local fast tests and PAR owners without inferring matching defects or support claims.
Refine implementation-ready gates while preserving scratch/repository-owned fixture policy and reduced validation cadence.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-01; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The reporter describes a released dwg2dxf path that exits successfully but emits malformed ASCII DXF for some CR-bearing TEXT/MTEXT strings, with a dropped character; a simple CR input did not reproduce the reported complex case.
sources.limits: Peer issue evidence only; the complex drawing was not available or independently reproduced, and it does not establish a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The reporter attributes missing block contents in dwg2dxf to a helper advancing its caller's object-array loop index, and reports per-block/count differences against the same-tree JSON reader on real drawings.
sources.limits: Peer source diagnosis and reported comparison; no customer drawing was obtained or run locally and no libdxfrw defect was confirmed.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The issue reports DXF importer edge cases involving zero-valued HATCH coordinates, unusual ATTDEF/ATTRIB tags, and embedded-MTEXT fields on multiline attributes.
sources.limits: Issue-author repro and proposed patch only; the embedded-field workaround is explicitly marked a stopgap, and source drawings/native behavior were not independently verified.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-08-14; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The reporter identifies repeated exact-size reallocations in LibreDWG's public block entity insertion path and presents normal-versus-batched timing measurements.
sources.limits: This concerns a separate library's construction API and cannot set libdxfrw performance thresholds.

sources.revision: Issue opened and closed 2026-10-16; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The maintainer reports an application-side heuristic that treated a polyline with at least 100,000 vertices as structurally invalid, causing recovery; the heuristic was removed in commit 04b2c07.
sources.limits: The linked public drawing was not fetched. This is evidence about that application's heuristic, not normative proof that every large polyline is valid or resource-safe.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-10-19; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The reporter describes one AC1027 drawing with an ACIS-based 3DSOLID rejected as type_code 37 with an invalid array count.
sources.limits: The source drawing is not public and OpenCADStudio shares the ACadRust codec lineage already represented in the plan; this is not independent parser evidence.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-10-17; mutable issue thread reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: A user reports slow window selection and orbiting on a large drawing, with a linked peer test archive.
sources.limits: The archive was not downloaded. The report does not isolate codec, scene construction, selection, renderer, or hardware costs.

sources.revision: Issue opened and reviewed 2026-10-20; mutable issue thread.
sources.observed: The maintainer attributes a repair prompt to DGN-derived records retained raw rather than typed and reports decode/display timings; the reporter says interaction remained sluggish.
sources.limits: The source drawing is confidential, only a repair log is attached, and the observations were not independently reproduced.

sources.observed: The documentation describes stock DWG interoperability as an external DWG-to-DXF converter followed by FreeCAD's standard DXF importer and notes incomplete entity coverage for LibreDWG.
sources.limits: Documentation is not a pinned runtime observation and includes conservative/older statements; it does not establish native Linux/Windows results or ACIS semantics.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw source and fast-test inventory
sources.observed: The inventory contains ASCII/Binary HATCH zero-Y controls, embedded-MTEXT ATTRIB/ATTDEF controls, text framing/refusal controls, bounded POLYLINE ownership/staging tests, and an LWPOLYLINE count cap of 1,000,000. PAR-141 already covers linearized attributed-INSERT staging concerns.
sources.limits: Source/test inventory is not a test execution or a complete performance audit; no local tests were run in this research pass.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-05 text and DXF output-integrity controls: separate process success, atomic publication, strict syntax, and semantic text retention.
PAR-06/PAR-49 source-to-output disposition: compare source and output identities by owner/block; aggregate counts are insufficient.
PAR-07/S8 composed-consumer evidence: distinguish codec acceptance, native importer capability, scene preparation, and interactive latency.
PAR-14 and POLYLINE resource gates: distinguish structural corruption from explicit resource-limit refusal and keep stress checks infrequent.

planChanges: Added a newest-research summary and detailed cross-project failure-shape/local-gate crosswalk.
Refined existing writer, source-to-output identity, resource-policy, and optional consumer-stage gates without adding a finding or top-level subplan.
Kept external fixtures out of the repository, fast-test cadence unchanged, and all six deferred external items non-promoting.
limitations: GitHub issue threads are mutable and provide peer-reported evidence; no peer executable was built or run.
No linked issue drawing/archive was downloaded; no independent strict-DXF parser or native CAD application was invoked.
Local conclusions are a source/test inventory only, not a full code audit or runtime qualification.
